MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Brake Command.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Brake Command.

BrakeCommandID.description: Unique identifier of this Brake Command instance.

BrakeCommandTime.description: Time this Brake Command was produced.

BrakeCommandSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Brake Command applies.

BrakeID.description: Identifier of the Brake to which this command is addressed.

TargetVelocity.description: Expected velocity (m/s) at the end of BrakeCommandTime.

BrakeCommandTime.description: Time after which TargetVelocity should be reached.

BrakePressureTarget.description: Target hydraulic or actuator line pressure (bar or Pa).

RegenerativeBrakeFraction.description: Fraction [0..1] of braking to be provided by the regenerative system.

ABSAllow.description: Indicates whether ABS is allowed to intervene during this command.

EmergencyBrakeFlag.description: Indicates that this is an autonomous emergency braking (AEB) request.

RampTime.description: Ramp-up/down time for achieving braking targets.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Brake Command in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Brake Command (plain text, max 2048 characters).
